parts.specification: 2.54 mm Dupont leads for ESP32, level-shifter, power, and LCD connections

parts.name: Bidirectional I2C level shifter
parts.specification: Two-channel or four-channel bidirectional module rated for 3.3 V LV and 5 V HV I2C operation

setup.summary: Open the protected setup page to enter Wi-Fi, weather coordinates, timezone, nine-screen order, and a 5-3600 second duration for each screen. Coarse coordinates are sent to the DS9 space-summary endpoint for planet visibility.

connections.to: GPIO21 through bidirectional I2C level shifter (HV1 to LV1)
GPIO22 through bidirectional I2C level shifter (HV2 to LV2)

warnings: The Inland KS0061 LCD is a 5 V module. Use the documented bidirectional I2C level shifter with LV at 3.3 V; never connect 5 V SDA/SCL pull-ups directly to ESP32 GPIO.
The scan reports possible responders only. PCF8574 has no device ID, so display writes remain restricted to the explicitly configured address 0x27.
Wiring, voltage behavior, address, and LCD operation are not yet physically verified on the named board.
